purpose: Prospectively define a source-native signed plant-position mapping for the v12 mechanism before calculating any new plant-level corolla-position to seed-fitness target from the Dryad files.

source_native_sampling.plants_per_site: approximately 30-40 focal plants depending on availability
source_native_sampling.corolla_length: 5-10 flowers per plant measured in mm; plant mean used in analyses
source_native_sampling.fitness: seed set per plant derived from seeds/flower x flowers/bract x bracts/plant
source_native_sampling.pollinator_observation: 12 h per site, species and sex of each hummingbird visitor recorded

dryad_files.name: Temeles et al Heliconia Bihai Population Data.XLS
dryad_files.role: plant-level floral trait and seed-set data

dryad_files.name: Temeles et al Heliconia caribaea red morph population data.XLS
dryad_files.role: plant-level red-morph floral trait and seed-set data

dryad_files.name: Temeles et al Heliconia caribaea yellow morph population data.XLS
dryad_files.role: plant-level yellow-morph floral trait and seed-set data

current_byte_recovery.environment_result: Dryad landing metadata available; individual XLS retrieval returned cache-miss/direct-download failure in the current execution environment

independent_mapping_source.title: Plant-pollinator interactions and floral convergence in two species of Heliconia from the Caribbean Islands
independent_mapping_source.role: functional-trait calibration only; no 2013 seed-fitness outcome enters the mapping
independent_mapping_source.source_interpretation: On Dominica, female E. jugularis with long bills are the primary visitors of long-corolla H. bihai, whereas male E. jugularis with shorter bills primarily visit shorter-corolla H. caribaea.

frozen_signed_position_mapping.mapping_type: two-anchor linear mechanical calibration from the independent 2011 Dominica source
frozen_signed_position_mapping.population_year_pollinator_center: Use source-native 2013 sex-specific E. jugularis visitation weights for the matching population/year/morph when those weights are recoverable from a stable source; center = weighted mean of 19.8 and 26.6 mm. Do not substitute a canonical sex when the population/year weights are unavailable.

interpretation.negative: plant lies shorter than the 2011 pollinator-calibrated corolla position
interpretation.positive: plant lies longer than the 2011 pollinator-calibrated corolla position
interpretation.zero: plant lies at the two-anchor calibrated position

future_target_contract.primary_question: Does signed initial corolla position predict the direction or magnitude of plant-level female-fitness selection on corolla length across Dominica population-year-morph units?
future_target_contract.trait: source-native plant mean corolla length in mm
future_target_contract.unit_of_independence: population x year x morph for selection-gradient comparison; plants are nested observations
forbidden_rescues: do not use the published 2013 selection-gradient sign to choose or alter the mapping
do not choose male versus female pollinator identity after inspecting plant seed-set results
do not infer missing sex-specific visitation weights from the floral phenotype
do not refit the 2011 bill-to-corolla slope against the 2013 fitness outcome
do not call literature-known selection patterns a fully held-out validation

known_literature_context_not_used_for_ma.article_summary: H. bihai generally shows directional selection for longer corollas; H. caribaea more often shows selection on bract number, with corolla selection less consistent.
known_literature_context_not_used_for_ma.rule: The exact signed-position statistic and its relation to raw plant-level seed fitness have not been calculated in this gate.

claim_boundary: This gate freezes source roles and a bill-to-corolla mapping from an independent ecological source. It does not yet test v12, does not estimate a universal floral optimum, and does not convert known narrative selection results into new evidence.
